title: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

title: Need Resource for Research\n
description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: Vital Resources Needed For Research
description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

title: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - Direct ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
description:
Hiya, 

Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board. 

If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  Make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Got a client at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, who needs their cargo picked up from Ruin Station. They’ve been waiting there a while and are starting to get a bit impatient. Any chance you could handle this for us? 

You’ll need a ship that can fit <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to be able to move them. 

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

title: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
description:
Hi, 

Several Citizens for Prosperity outposts in Pyro need supplies. It seems like we regularly do runs like this for them, but this one looks like it might be a bit riskier. A CFP rep let me know that outlaw activity around these sites has spiked recently, but they desperately need these outposts restocked, so we’re going ahead with the delivery. <EM4>Just a head’s up that you could run into trouble, so come prepared</EM4>.       

All the cargo’s waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and here’s where it’s heading:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

According to the manifest, the largest cargo container you’ll need to deal with is <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>. Aside from that, remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.    

~mission(Contractor|SignOff) 
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. title: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - Direct ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
description:
Hiya, 

Here’s the deal, I need someone good for a special run. We’ve got an important client that’s threatening to take their business elsewhere, because their deliveries are consistently missing cargo. They’re demanding that 100% of the cargo be delivered on this run, or they won’t pay. Since this was before my time and my supervisor wants to show that it won’t happen again, they agreed with this. Anyway, I think you might be a good fit. 

If you’re willing to take that risk too, here are all the pertinent details. The cargo can be collected from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and delivered to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Looks like the largest cargo container you’ll need to handle is <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>, so be sure to bring a ship big enough and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to help you move those containers around.  
 
~mission(Contractor|SignOff) 

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Thanks for the assistance,
 
Lima Endicott

title: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

title: Protect ~mission(Location) from XenoThreat Incursion
description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe ~mission(Location|Address) off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to ~mission(Location|Address) and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters. 

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by ~mission(TargetName), a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and ~mission(TargetName|Last) taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Retaking Outposts from Headhunters
description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near ~mission(Location|Address) from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by ~mission(TargetName) and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that ~mission(TargetName|Last) tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near ~mission(Location|Address) that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out ~mission(TargetName), who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott

title: ~mission(Location|Address) needs help
description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against ~mission(Location) by a large group of armed individuals led by ~mission(TargetName), a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Intercepted Supply Run
description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Recovering Valuable Supplies
description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination)</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Special Recovery Operation
description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

title: Red Level Contract: Clear PAFs, Recover Cargo, and Deliver to OLP
description:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> and <EM4>~mission(Location2|Address)</EM4>, but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>.  It also wouldn't hurt to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.   

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.

description:

Ship support is needed at <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.  

Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> if all goes down without a hitch.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

title: Red Level Contract: Support VIP Clients
description:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation. 

If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

title: Red Level Contract: High-Risk Security Patrol
description:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore. 

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.</EM4>

title: Red Level Contract: Secure Threatened Space
description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Power Usage Data
description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Energy Anomaly data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

title: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

title: Orison Relief: Small Fabrication Order
description:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint outlining what materials you'll need to create them. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. Either way you will need access to an Item Fabricator to make the propulsors yourself.

Once you're done bring them to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

title: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit ~mission(Location|Address). It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

title: Hitting a CFP site
description:
Need someone to sweep ~mission(Location|Address). CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge. 

Need it done fast and clean. 

Stows out.

title: Wipe ~mission(Location) out
description:
Caught wind that a crew of hardcore shipjackers are holed up around ~mission(Location|Address). They swiped a couple of Headhunter ships a few months ago after dumping the crew out the airlock, so we've been keeping an eye out for them ever since.

Want you to go there and show them the same kinda mercy they showed our people. Clear?

Stows out.

title: Turf War
description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over ~mission(Location|Address). We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

title: Kill Kopions at ~mission(Location)
description:
Bunch of kopions set up shop in Headhunter territory. Mean ones. Having to fight off wild animals every few hours is making it tough to do business. 

If you get rid of them for us, you get paid. Do it however you want – as long as they end up dead. 

You can find them at ~mission(Location|Address).

-Stows

title: Butcher Kopion Pack at ~mission(Location)
description:
Huge swarm of kopions ran down one of our Clips the other day. Never found the body. Word is they ate the poor bastard. 

We need someone to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and shoot every kopion they see. Don't stop ’til the assholes are all dead. 

Watch your back when you go in. If you can’t guess, these bastards are mean. If you get yourself killed, that's on you. 

Stows out.

title: Need a hitter
description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near ~mission(Location|Address). I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

title: Death and cargo
description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to ~mission(Location|Address) where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to ~mission(Destination|Address) and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

title: A tricky tricky task
description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent ~mission(TargetName) undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, ~mission(TargetName|First) was heading to ~mission(Location|Address) to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid ~mission(TargetName|Last) might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last) and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at ~mission(Destination|Address) and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.

title: Reputation Management
description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ~mission(Location|Address). We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  ~mission(Location|Address) and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

description:

All the best,

Vaughn

description:

It is highly likely that you will find them at ~mission(Location|Address).  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

title: A Well Deserved Break
description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, ~mission(TargetName), who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at ~mission(Location|Address).  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

title: They Will Be Missed
description:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

title: All Things Come To An End
description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with ~mission(Location|Address), but ~mission(TargetName) is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

title: End of a Salamander
description:
One of the leaders of the mysterious Claw Salamanders gang, a ~mission(TargetName), has worn out their welcome and has now become our problem to deal with. It's hardly a surprise figuring no one except their friends could understand what they're saying. 

Unfortunately, it won't be as easy as heading to ~mission(Location|Address) and dealing with them directly. Not only will you have to ensure the station is operational to reach them, it seems that you will have to draw them out of hiding too by taking out a fair number of their compatriots first.

Not the simplest of jobs, but I'm sure you'll rise to the occasion.

All the best,
Vaughn

title: Small Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

~mission(Hint_Location) For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>~mission(Hint_Tool)</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*: </EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>exclusive mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

"We’ve got your back"
